description: Read back a device's answer to an actionable push (#75) by the correlation_id returned from send_push. Returns the push_responses row { correlation_id, device_uuid, action (accept|reject|skip), context, responded_at, action_intent } or null if the user hasn't responded yet. action_intent (or null) carries the SERVER-RECORDED action-binding + its outcome: { action_kind, params, issued_by, created_at, executed_at, result } — so you learn BOTH the user's choice and what the binding actually did (e.g. block_rule_toggle result.enabled_after).

correlation_id.description: The correlation_id returned by send_push when actionable:true.

name: get_push_response
title: Get Push Response
